Scenario fixture: a11ycore-heading-order

01 — CANTTELL: heading level jumps from 1 to 3, skipping level 2

Skipped level

This rule needs at least two headings to evaluate, and the violation is inherently a relationship between two headings rather than a single element, so a single-page fixture demonstrating just the FAIL branch is the clearest form. The PASS cases (consecutive levels; decreasing levels; a later heading revisiting a level already reached earlier in the document, e.g. h1,h2,h3,h2,h4) are covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file.
